objective: Durably preserve the complete reasoning lineage, falsifiers, demoted ideas, external semantic-source findings, and live integration boundary from the 2026-10-09 context-dependent-meaning research so future workers do not repeat the same search or silently weaken the truth conditions.

selected_problem.original_question: Profit margin, collateral margin, interest-rate spread margin, page margin, another domain sense, or an unmodeled meaning?
selected_problem.actual_goal: Return sound goal-relevant conclusions without requiring a unique lexical sense when the source does not justify one.

final_truth_reduction.information_theoretic_boundary: IF_TWO_SOURCE_AND_CONTEXT_CONSISTENT_INTERPRETATIONS_REMAIN_AND_THEY_CHANGE_THE_REQUIRED_OUTPUT__NO_SYSTEM_CAN SOUNDLY CHOOSE BETWEEN THEM WITHOUT AUTHORIZED_DISCRIMINATING_INFORMATION

research_lineage.name: CANDIDATE_SENSE_CONTRACTS_AND_HARD_CONSTRAINTS
retained: Represent candidate senses as explicit contracts with domain, types, arguments, units, relations, synonyms, incompatibilities and provenance.
Build context from sentence, neighborhood, document structure, tables, units, entities, definitions, task and file/domain metadata.
Apply hard type/schema/unit/definition constraints before soft ranking.
Include UNKNOWN_OR_OTHER rather than forcing the nearest known sense.
Resolve only to goal-relevant granularity.
research_lineage.corrected: A candidate inventory is not automatically complete; no ranking method can repair an omitted true interpretation.

research_lineage.name: SENSE_LATTICES_TARGET_SENSE_VERIFICATION_AND_DECISION_THEORY
retained: Use hierarchical semantic partitions rather than assuming a flat dictionary.
Separate candidate proposal from candidate verification.
Keep supporting and contradicting evidence distinct.
Use counterfactual consequences and strongest-rival checks.
Distinguish evidence uncertainty, model uncertainty and ontology/candidate-space uncertainty.
Use value-of-information style clarification only when ambiguity can change the current decision.
research_lineage.corrected: Confidence or repeated model agreement is not proof of semantic completeness.

research_lineage.name: OPEN_WORLD_RESIDUAL_AND_SEMANTIC_CEGAR
retained: Known candidate regions must coexist with an explicit unmodeled residual.
Refine semantic partitions only when a surviving distinction can change the decision.
Counterexample search is useful for finding omitted interpretations but failure to find one is never universal completeness proof.
research_lineage.corrected: Do not quantify over all conceivable human meanings unless a separately proved bounded universe justifies it.

research_lineage.name: UNDERSPECIFIED_SEMANTIC_VARIABLE_AND_INVARIANT_CONSEQUENCE
retained: Represent ambiguous occurrences as underspecified semantic variables.
A conclusion is safe when it is invariant over all currently admissible interpretations.
When results diverge, construct a minimal witness pair and acquire only the discriminator needed to separate their decision consequences.
Multiple simultaneous meanings and conflicting context are legitimate states, not resolver failures.
research_lineage.corrected: A word sense is occurrence-scoped, not globally bound by surface form or whole document.

research_lineage.name: PROOF_CARRYING_SEMANTIC_EFFECTS
retained_as_general_safety_pattern: Unresolved semantic dependencies should not silently disappear across summaries, tools, agents or serialization.
Removing a material semantic dependency requires a discharge proof: evidence, invariance, explicit branch preservation, or an explicitly risk-bounded non-formal contract.
Formal, risk-bounded, empirical and unresolved guarantees must remain distinct.
Later contradictory evidence must invalidate dependent semantic certificates.
research_lineage.current_brain_reconciliation: Do not build a second global semantic-effect subsystem. Current Brain mechanisms already cover the important open-world, monotone, query-relative effect, discriminator and provenance invariants. Reintroduce a new effect layer only after a concrete leak counterexample survives those mechanisms.

research_lineage.name: DEMAND_DRIVEN_SEMANTIC_SLICING
retained: Semantic uncertainty may flow forward while goal requirements flow backward.
Only their intersection should activate expensive semantic work.
Cache proof certificates by exact source/context/version and invalidate only affected dependents.
research_lineage.current_brain_reconciliation: Equivalent functionality is already represented by policy-adequacy quotienting, query-relative effect reasoning, selected discriminators and direct adequacy routes. Do not duplicate.

research_lineage.name: INDEPENDENT_NONINTERFERENCE_AUDITOR
retained_as_testing_pattern: A dependency graph can itself be incomplete; independent perturbation/fresh replay can discover missing semantic dependencies.
For nondeterministic model-backed components compare behavior distributions or repeated matched interventions, not one sample.
An auditor must not rely on the dependency graph it is testing.
research_lineage.critical_correction: Counterfactual semantic interventions must be admissible under all non-target verified evidence. Impossible worlds are invalid falsifiers.
research_lineage.current_brain_reconciliation: Useful for adversarial verification when a real dependency-leak counterexample appears; not the present critical path.

research_lineage.name: LIVE_REPO_RECONCILIATION
research_lineage.discovery: Most general correctness machinery was already owned in narrower verified form.
research_lineage.scheduler_consequence: Do not build general WSD, generic semantic effects, generic Horn/Datalog, or a generic OWL reasoner unless a concrete surviving case proves the missing mechanism is load-bearing.

alternative_considered.not_selected_as_new_trusted_semantic_aut: The Brain should own consequential semantic/policy logic; current bounded PRs deliberately verify exact source bytes and metadata rather than delegating policy meaning to a general processor.

demoted_or_deferred_ideas.reason: Important safety idea but largely duplicates existing Brain open-world, effect, policy-quotient, provenance and discriminator machinery; no current concrete leak proves a new global layer is load-bearing.

Positive Horn provenance is sound in principle, but building it without a concrete finance case would be speculative infrastructure. Prefer the smallest verifier-backed refiner required by an actual surviving case.
Ontology reasoning can prove consequences only after concept binding. Raw text to concept identity remains the difficult authority boundary. Use bounded ontology adapters instead.
Union increases coverage but does not prove exhaustion of open-world human/domain meaning.
Calibrated or empirical confidence may guide search or explicitly risk-bounded workflows; it is not logical proof.
